description:
Convert a fiat amount across one or more target currencies using ECB daily reference rates via Frankfurter. Returns both unit rates and the converted amounts.

upAPI operation `currency-convert.get` (Finance). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

amount.description: Amount of the base currency to convert
amount.title: Amount

targets.description: Comma-separated ISO-4217 target currency codes (e.g. EUR,GBP,JPY)
targets.title: Targets

name: currency_convert_get
title: Convert Currency
